newsitem.title: SPAIN: Tabacalera says disposals income 20 bln pta.
newsitem.headline: Tabacalera says disposals income 20 bln pta.

text.p: Spain's Tabacalera said on Wednesday it would receive disposals income totalling 20 billion pesetas after it sold a 9.66 percent stake in Koipe, a 4.72 percent stake in Ebro and 31.8 percent of Intabex.

Chairman Cesar Alierta told shareholders in the tobacco producer and distributor that the investments in food firms were not very profitable, and the stakes were sold at attractive prices, particularly in the case of vegetable oil maker Koipe.
"The sale of all these stakes has meant a funds inflow of nearly 20 billion pesetas, and the acquisitions we hope to make in businesses we know better amply surpass this figure," Alierta said.
